sourcePolicy: Dolphin source and Gecko crates are owned by the unified Wii OS product under src/dolphin and crates/gecko-*. Preserve their upstream revisions, build adapters, and license notices.

components.role: Shared menu state C ABI and C host
components.integration: Shared state API; renderers consume the opaque C ABI or Rust/WASM library.
Build with its configure.py/Ninja flow; outputs main.dol, not a WAD. Keep separate from host C libraries.
Build examples independently with the upstream devkitPro Makefiles.

components.role: Wii/GameCube ISO, WBFS, WDF and archive tooling in C
components.integration: Build wit/wwt/wdf/wfuse through setup.sh and the project Makefiles; expose tools as CLI subprocesses.

components.role: Patched Dolphin source snapshot integrated into Wii OS with its pinned C/C++ externals
components.integration: This local snapshot is the Wii OS Dolphin implementation source; retain its pinned revision and per-project license notices.

components.role: Wii/GameCube emulator runtime with native and browser WebGPU frontends
components.integration: Build from the flat root Cargo workspace; Dolphin DSP fallback files are shared from src/dolphin and no duplicate Dolphin source tree is used.

notes: The generated inventory is authoritative for individual paths, hashes, revisions, dirty state, and license-file hashes.
A .c extension identifies a C translation unit; .h/.hh headers can be C, C++, or dual-use and are reported as ambiguous.
The inventory has one canonical Dolphin source root and one Gecko runtime root inside the Wii OS product; Gecko does not carry a second Dolphin source tree.
User-provided Wii titles, WADs, NAND images, extracted channel banners, and boot video files remain local runtime assets and are never committed or included by this catalog.
